crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering…
On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he…

translations.web: “ ‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.
translations.bsb: And you shall count off seven Sabbaths of years—seven times seven years—so that the seven Sabbaths of years amount to forty-nine years.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
translations.asv: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and there shall be unto thee the days of seven sabbaths of years, even forty and nine years.
